title: Paris and Switzerland: Eiffel Tower to Mount Rigi
alt: The Eiffel Tower seen across the Seine at dusk
transport: Private airport transfers, rail to Zurich and a Swiss Travel Pass

stops.name: Paris

activities.description: A 24 hour open top ticket past the Louvre, the Arc de Triomphe, Notre Dame and the Champs Elysees, hopping off where you like.

activities.name: Eiffel Tower second floor tickets
activities.description: Skip the line admission to the second floor by the stairs, the level where the ironwork and the city both read best.

activities.name: Disneyland Paris

program.name: Paris
program.description: Three nights on the Seine by the Eiffel Tower, with an open top bus pass, the second floor by stairs and a free day for Disneyland.

program.name: Zurich

expert.name: Sharon
expert.quote: Three nights in Paris and three in Switzerland, with a hotel on the Seine looking at the Eiffel Tower. It is the honeymoon shape couples ask for most.
expert.tip: Take the second floor by the stairs rather than queueing for the summit lift. You get closer to the ironwork and you skip the longest queue in Paris.

summary: Seven days between Paris and the Swiss Alps: three nights on the Seine with an open top bus pass and the Eiffel Tower, then three nights in Zurich with a travel pass, Mount Rigi, Lake Lucerne and the Rhine Falls.
included: Included: 3 nights in Paris and 3 nights in Zurich with breakfast; airport transfers; rail from Paris to Zurich; a 24 hour Paris hop on hop off bus ticket; skip the line Eiffel Tower second floor tickets; a four day Swiss Travel Pass; the Mount Rigi and Lucerne day trip with a lake cruise; a Rhine Falls boat tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; the optional Disneyland Paris day; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
